items.title: Is Ciena (CIEN) Too Expensive After Its 7x Run?
items.summary: Ciena has been on a remarkable multi year run, yet the recent swings in its share price put a sharper spotlight on a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation still grounded in the company’s earnings power, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying profit story? Over the past 3 years the stock has delivered a very large gain of about 7x, which raises the stakes for whether the profit base can support that kind of repricing.
